title: Interest redemption cancellation succeeded
description: This event occurs when a redemption is successfully canceled with product interest management.

external_cancellation_id.title: External cancellation ID
external_cancellation_id.description: External identifier for the cancellation request.

external_redemption_id.title: External redemption ID
external_redemption_id.description: External identifier for the canceled redemption operation.

external_quota_id.title: External quota ID
external_quota_id.description: External identifier for the quota the redemption belongs to.

external_asset_id.title: External asset ID
external_asset_id.description: Unique asset identifier defined by Pismo.

restored_units.title: Restored units
restored_units.description: Units returned to the quota balance by the cancellation.

quota_reopened.title: Quota reopened
quota_reopened.description: Indicates whether the quota went from REDEEMED back to ACTIVE.

asset_reopened.title: Asset reopened
asset_reopened.description: Indicates whether the asset went from REDEEMED back to ACTIVE.
